howTo.title: How to Create a Receipt Online
howTo.subtitle: Issue professional receipts in seconds with our serverless generator.

steps.title: Select Receipt Mode and Enter Details
steps.description: Choose between Itemized, Cash, or Payment receipt modes. Enter your business name and customer details.
steps.tip: Cash mode generates a rapid, simple cash payment voucher without line-item tables.

steps.title: Add Items and Record Payment Method
steps.description: Specify goods or services sold, tax rates, payment date, and transaction reference (such as UPI, Card, or Bank Transfer).
steps.tip: Payment receipts link directly to past invoice numbers for clean accounting reconciliation.

steps.title: Download Clean PDF or Print Instantly
steps.description: Export a crisp vector PDF, high-res PNG, or print directly to paper with an official green 'PAID IN FULL' stamp.
steps.tip: Receipts save locally in your browser so you never lose your draft.

whatItMustContain.title: What an Official Receipt Must Contain
whatItMustContain.subtitle: Six essential components needed to make a receipt valid for accounting, tax filings, and audits.
whatItMustContain.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. Check your local rules.

items.title: Merchant Information and Tax ID
items.description: Trading name, business address, email, phone number, and tax registration number (such as GSTIN, VAT, or EIN).

items.title: Buyer / Customer Name
items.description: Full legal name or corporate entity name of the person or business who made the payment.

items.title: Unique Receipt Number and Date
items.description: A sequential receipt number and the exact calendar date payment was received [Verify with official source: commercial bookkeeping record retention rules].

items.title: Clear Itemized Description
items.description: Specific description of goods delivered or services rendered, including quantities and unit prices.

items.title: Payment Method and Reference ID
items.description: Payment mode (Credit Card, Cash, Bank Transfer, or UPI) and any transaction authorization code.

items.title: Remaining Balance Paid ($0.00)
items.description: Explicit confirmation that the bill has been settled in full with no outstanding balance remaining.

faq.title: Receipt Generator FAQs
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding receipt types, PDF exports, and data privacy.

items.question: What is the difference between an invoice and a receipt?
items.answer: An invoice is a bill sent before payment to request money owed. A receipt is an acknowledgment issued after payment as proof that money was received.

items.question: Can I generate receipts on my mobile phone?
items.answer: Yes. The interface is optimized for mobile phones with a quick toggle between editing your receipt and viewing the live preview.

items.question: Is my customer data stored on a remote server?
items.answer: No. Online Invoice Creator is 100% serverless. All receipt calculations and PDF rendering take place directly inside your web browser.

items.question: Are there any watermarks on the receipts?
items.answer: No. All PDF and PNG downloads are completely watermark-free and suitable for official commercial accounting.
